answer: Make the agent economy a guarded lagoon, not an open haven for clones: every agent locks 500 POA for 30 days and binds one verified device key before earning. A farm spawning 1,000 fakes must stake 500,000 POA and wait a month, raising attacker cost far above any single-epoch payout. Detection fires when over 40% of an agent's peers share one funding source or file near-identical work within 10 minutes; on the horizon, auditors trace the cluster, slash 50% of its stake, and ban the device keys, so one caught farm funds the honest pool instead of draining it.
